summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release disclosing share repurchases under a program announced June 9, 2026. Between June 22-26, 2026, it repurchased 83,530 shares on Euronext Amsterdam at an average price of €25.24, for total consideration of €2,108,045.52. Prices ranged from €24.38 to €25.82. Post-repurchase, Lakefront holds 199,734 treasury shares. This is an issuer buyback returning capital to shareholders. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for filing of program completion and potential impact on share count.
